Contributing to lunarcast

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for considering a contribution. This outlines how to propose a change.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue at https://github.com/novrisuhermi/lunarcast/issues with a minimal reproducible example (the reprex package helps). For holiday dates, please include an official source.

Fixing typos

Small fixes to the documentation can be proposed directly on GitHub. Please edit the roxygen comments in the .R files under R/, not the generated .Rd files under man/.

Bigger changes

  1. Open an issue first to discuss the change.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch.
  3. Make the change, add tests in tests/testthat/ and a bullet to NEWS.md.
  4. Run devtools::document(), devtools::test() and devtools::check(); the check should report no errors, warnings or notes.
  5. Open a pull request.

The code follows the tidyverse style guide.

Code of Conduct

Please note that the lunarcast project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing to this project you agree to abide by its terms.
